title: Request for p-adic to Finite-Quotient Reduction Lemma
body_html:
Request for p-adic to Finite-Quotient Reduction Lemma

Prove a reduction lemma for the p-adic theta argument that identifies the finite quotient action in each generalized lattice model with Gérardin's finite-field Weil representation.

The lemma should specify:

  • the lattice \(L=\mathcal{B}_{z,0}\) and dual lattice \(L^{\mathrm{sh}}\);
  • the finite symplectic quotient \(\ell_L=L/L^{\mathrm{sh}}\);
  • the stabilizer \(K_L\) and pro-unipotent kernel \(K_L^+\);
  • the reduction map \(K_L\to \operatorname{Sp}(\ell_L)\);
  • compatibility between the lattice-model splitting of the metaplectic cover and the finite Weil action on the fiber;
  • behavior under orthogonal direct sums of finite quotient symplectic spaces.

Until this lemma is proved, finite-field Weil character formulas should be cited only as finite quotient input, not as direct p-adic character formulas.

deps.title: Finite-Field Weil Input for p-adic Lattice Models
